name: com.loreman.unity
description: Plays the dialogues of a Loreman project in Unity. A .lorebuild file made by Loreman is turned into Addressables and Unity Localization tables, so a dialogue and its texts are loaded only when the game needs them.

samples.description: Open the scene and press Play: a complete dialogue with choices, voice-over and a language switch, using the package API directly. Brings its own demo build.
Open the scene and press Play: preload a dialogue, save the place in it and resume, read the designer's note of a line. Brings its own demo build.
A custom dialogue screen on a Canvas: typed-out lines, answer buttons, language buttons. Needs com.unity.ugui. Brings its own demo build.
A custom dialogue screen in UI Toolkit (UXML + USS): typed-out lines, answer buttons, language buttons. Brings its own demo build.
